title: Who Powers Tokenized Funds? Infrastructure and Disclosure Review
period: October 2026 expanded edition, as of 23 October; original twenty observations retain their 21 October checks
unit: Named fund, sub-fund or feeder product; not issuer, blockchain deployment or dollar of assets
selection: Purposive public-documentation sample: the unchanged twenty products of edition 2026-10-v1, plus six separately documented products: SWEEP, VBILL, JAAA, MCGXX, SPXA and JLTXX. Original sources retain their 21 October review dates; added sources were checked 23 October. This twenty-six-product roster is not a random, exhaustive or AUM-ranked market sample. A fund, sub-fund or feeder is counted once, regardless of blockchain deployments.
unknownMeaning: Not verified in the listed reviewed sources. This does not mean the provider or role does not exist, nor that other public or investor-only documents omit it.

roles.label: Fund custody / depositary
roles.definition: Named custody or depositary appointment for the reviewed fund's assets. Investor-wallet support and the custody of an underlying fund are not inherited.

roles.label: Fund administration
roles.definition: Explicit fund administrator or accounting/administrative agent. A NAV calculation agent or token administrator alone does not qualify.

roles.label: Transfer agency
roles.definition: Explicit transfer-agent appointment or delegation. A platform or distribution relationship alone does not qualify.

roles.label: Token / share-record infrastructure
roles.definition: Named tokenization platform, token administrator, vault developer or share-register operator, with the exact function retained. These functions are not equivalent services.
